messages:
maya_eval: FYI uploaded a long-doc slice heatmap from this morning's int8 bring-up. Seeing concentrated regressions on >2k token docs, esp. in instruction-follow prompts. attaching snapshot and quick notes. :eyes:
cecilia: ugh. is this across all topologies or just the nf4-int8 build?
samir: looks like nvf32 -> int8 path. initial suspicion: kv-cache eviction behavior + quant bias on attention weights under long context.
jin: can you paste the heatmap? also what were canary traffic fractions and duration?
maya_eval: heatmap: (inline) rows=slices, cols=metric deltas. key numbers: long-doc F1 delta = -0.028, ROUGE-L delta = -0.022, hallucination-rate +3.6pp. Canary was 1% traffic for 45m. Sample counts: ~650 requests on long-doc slice.
cecilia: sample size is borderline for stable stats but delta magnitude is concerning. our auto-fallback config says fail if delta <= -0.02 and p<0.05 with min_samples 500 for slice. this meets min_samples and delta. ops-bot, did the canary finish or is it still rolling?
ops-bot: deploy check: canary 1717264000 finished at 1717265400, no auto-fallback triggered because p-value estimate returned 0.07 (insufficient).
samir: p=0.07 is noisy given distribution skew. we should consider effect-size + bootstrap CI instead of relying on asymptotic p. for low samples, p can be misleading.
jin: agree. propose two immediate actions: 1) pause further promotion. 2) run targeted shadow at 5% for long-doc slice for 2h to get better statistics. also run a deterministic KV-cache trace to compare generation tokens and attention norms.
maya_eval: running 5% shadow now. starting analyzer job: 
```python
python infra/evals/run_slice_watch.py --slice long-doc --model rwd-v5-int8 --duration 2h --collect-attn=1
```
will post logs.
cecilia: for rollout gate policy, suggestion: add a slice-hardened rule that auto-fails when delta <= -0.02 AND (bootstrap CI upper bound < -0.01) OR delta worse AND latency tail increase > 25ms. we saw latency tail jump in a few requests.
samir: proposal config snippet (draft):
```
"slice_auto_fallback": {
  "delta_threshold": -0.02,
  "min_samples": 500,
  "bootstrap_upper_bound_threshold": -0.01,
  "latency_p95_ms_delta": 25,
  "require_either": true
}
```
This means fail if delta <= -0.02 AND (bootstrap CI upper < -0.01 OR p95_delta > 25ms).
jin: I like require_either, because some slices show quality-only regressions, others have perf issues. also add a probation window: if auto-fallback triggers, rollback for 1h then shadow at 5% for 6h before re-evaluate.
maya_eval: running quick concordance check vs fp16 baseline on 200 canned long-doc prompts now. early look: token-level mismatch concentrated near lengthy instruction boundaries. sample from run: 
```
--- prompt id 9823 ---
baseline: "...then summarize the last 800 tokens focusing on key decisions."
int8:    "...then summarize the last 800 tokens focusing on the key decisions."  <-- extra determiners, changed emphasis
```
Not huge but systematic.
cecilia: could be quantization bias on output layer projection. we should run weight-clipping ablations and per-channel scaling if not already enabled. also check layernorm quant prec.
samir: ops: add a temporary routing rule: route long-doc requests to fp16 fallback for next 6h for hosted tier to protect prod. we can keep the canary in the quiet bucket.
ops-bot: routing change queued: route long-doc -> rwd-v5-fp16 for hosted-prod. will take effect in 60s unless cancelled.
maya_eval: thanks. after shadow 5% collects enough samples I'll post bootstrap CIs and confusion matrices.
jin: can we also add an AB test with metric composite (F1_weighted - 0.5*latency_penalty) so single metric captures perf-quality tradeoff? set auto-fallback if composite delta < -0.015 with min_samples 2000.
cecilia: note for policy team: we should avoid blanket numeric thresholds that ignore slice semantics. recommend per-slice baseline thresholds based on historical variance. long-doc historically has higher variance, so our min_samples maybe should be 1000 not 500 for that slice.
samir: agree. action items: 1) maya run 5% shadow and post results 2) infra add temp route to fp16 for long-doc 3) research run per-channel quant ablations and weight-clipping experiments 4) policy: add per-slice min_samples override and bootstrap CI rule.
maya_eval: noted. starting run. ping me if you want raw traces. :shipit:
cecilia: thanks — keep thread updated. once we have bootstrap CI and composite AB numbers we'll decide on promote vs rollback. :thumbsup:
